text: 记者获悉，微信香港钱包（WeChat Pay HK）携手中国工商银行（深圳分行）、广东华兴银行（深圳分行）及中国银行（深圳分行），正式上线深圳离境退税服务。微信香港钱包用户可在深圳6个离境退税口岸及提供“即买即退”服务的商圈退税点办理退税手续，退税款可直接以港币存入微信香港钱包余额。（界面新闻）
text_en: Reporters learned that WeChat Pay HK, in partnership with ICBC (Shenzhen Branch), Guangdong Huaxing Bank (Shenzhen Branch), and Bank of China (Shenzhen Branch), has officially launched Shenzhen departure tax refund services. WeChat Pay HK users can complete tax refund procedures at six departure tax refund ports in Shenzhen and at tax refund points in shopping districts offering 'instant rebate' services, with refunds directly credited to their WeChat Pay HK balance in Hong Kong dollars. (Jiemian News)
